newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Virgin says keen on "super jumbo" jet.
newsitem.headline: Virgin says keen on "super jumbo" jet.

text.p: British entrepreneur Richard Branson said on Tuesday he would welcome the development of "Super Jumbo" jets and would order them for his Virgin Atlantic Airways airline.

"We've actually said to Boeing we would like to be one of their launch customers," Branson told a news conference here to promote the launch of the Brussels-Copenhagen link for his cut-price regional airline Virgin Express.
Planemakers like Boeing, McDonnell Douglas and European aircraft consortium Airbus plan to introduce jumbo planes that will dwarf the Boeing B747 now in use.

"We would like it to happen. (Airport) slots become scarce and even without low-fare travel the forecast is that twice as many people will be travelling by air by 2003. If you add low fare travel on top of that there will be enormous demand," Branson said.
The new generation of large aircraft would seat 600 people against 400 for the B747-400.
